    • setVisibilityPredicateSupplierTransformer

      public ContainerConfiguration setVisibilityPredicateSupplierTransformer(Function<Supplier<Predicate>, Supplier<Predicate>> supplierTransformer)
      Description copied from interface: ContainerConfiguration
      Allows customizing visibility predicate supplier. If ContainerConfiguration.getJSR330ComponentVisibilityFollowsPlexusVisibility() is set to true, container will use the default predicate supplier. This method allows programmatic altering of default supplier, for example by wrapping it, replacing it. The supplied function will receive the default supplier, must return a non null instance. By default, this function is set to Function.identity().
      Specified by:
      setVisibilityPredicateSupplierTransformer in interface ContainerConfiguration
      Parameters:
      supplierTransformer - the supplier transformer, may be null meaning "identity" (the default value).

    • getVisibilityPredicateSupplierTransformer

      public Function<Supplier<Predicate>, Supplier<Predicate>> getVisibilityPredicateSupplierTransformer()
      Description copied from interface: ContainerConfiguration
      Returns the configured visibility predicate supplier, never null. The default transformer is Function.identity().
